Definition: from G1909 and G1093; worldly (physically or morally):--earthly, in earth, terrestrial.
BiblicalUsage: Epigeios means earthly, of the earth — the things of this world set against the things above. If I have told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe heavenly things; there are celestial bodies and bodies terrestrial; our earthly house of this tabernacle shall be dissolved; and the wisdom that is earthly is sensual, devilish.
TheologicalSignificance: Earthly wisdom and earthly houses pass, and only what is heavenly endures. I believe the word draws the line I live on every day, and I must not build my hope on what dissolves.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Paul; James, Brother of Jesus
